about: Byte samples of the output lines of the NetTest specification (section 'Output lines'). statistics: the deltas of an interval of the real length interval_ns, per instance, and the text of the block, lines separated by \n without the last line break. runtime: the samples at the start and the end of the interval (cumulative gc_count, gc_time_ms, cpu_ns; null when absent) and the line. grouping: integers and their text. captured: lines printed by the SDK tools.
